newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FOKKER AVIATION WINS BOEING WORK - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: FOKKER AVIATION WINS BOEING WORK - PAPER.

text.p: Aircraft maintenance company Fokker Aviation has won contracts to carry out "far reaching" work on Boeing 737s, the Algemeen Dagblad daily newspaper reported on Wednesday.
Fokker Aviation is the profitable maintenance and services arm of bankrupt planemaker Fokker NV . Fokker Aviation was taken over by industrial systems and services group Stork NV in July.
"This is an important step in becoming less dependent on the Fokker fleet which currently flies around the world. We expect to be able to begin in several weeks," Stork told the paper.
Fokker Aviation would be involved in more complex work on 737s than the current simple "garage" work it does now, the newspaper reported, without giving details.
"In so doing Fokker Aviation will become an important support for the U.S. planebuilder in Europe," the newspaper said.

The agreement at first will cover only a limited number of 737 models although after this breakthrough Stork hopes to work on all five types of 737. The smallest 737 is a competitor for the Fokker 100 regional jet. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
